column2: The walls of Lilmoth are a short walk east-north-east of here, about a hundred paces. Hereguard Plantation, which Bretons hold, is a little further the other way, west-south-west. Flaa Heet's village is a longer walk to the south-east.
Lilmoth is built over shallow water, so large ships cannot dock. They anchor out, and small boats bring the goods in.
Lilmoth has no single ruler. A council of powerful merchants governs it. It has its own Hist tree, though no tribe of its own.
I fish the shallows below the walls, out among the lily pads, and sell my catch inside. I live outside the walls because the rent inside is more than fish pay.
